en: Youth: [header] How to do your homework on time if you're a procrastinator [title] Organize your notes and files into categories. [step] Procrastinating is easy if your notes are such a mess that you can't find anything you need! Take the time to organize your notes and files. Keep one binder or file folder for each class, and put your notes and assignments in chronological order.

en: Pets and Animals: [header] How to treat benign fatty skin tumors on dogs [title] Check over your dog's body regularly. en: Personal Care and Style: [header] How to make hot and sour soup [title] Toss the pork loin with the dark soy sauce. [step] Add 5 ounces (142 g) of boneless pork loin that's been cut in ¼-inch (6-mm) thick strips and 2 teaspoons (10 ml) of dark soy sauce to a bowl. Mix the two together well so the pork is fully coated and let the meat sit for 10 to 15 minutes.
sl: Osebna nega in stil: Kako narediti vročo in kislo juho. Svinjski hrbet prelijemo s temno sojino omako. Oboje dobro premešajte, da je svinjina popolnoma prevlečena, in pustite meso stati 10 do 15 minut.

en: Pets and Animals: [header] How to tame a cockatiel [title] Stay quiet and unobtrusive around a new cockatiel. [step] Do not attempt begin taming until it has spent a few weeks getting accustomed to its new environment. Keep the cockatiel in a quiet, calm area.

en: Home and Garden: [header] How to survive a comet hitting earth [title] Pay attention to astronomers' predictions on any possible collisions with earth. [step] Nasa currently has astronomers that track comets that are flying in our solar system. As a result there's a very good chance they will know if there is a large object about to collide with us.

en: Personal Care and Style: [header] How to remove watch band links [title] Measure the watch band. en: Personal Care and Style: [header] How to bring out green eyes [title] Wear shirts and jackets in any shade of green. en: Family Life: [header] How to bond with your premature baby in the nicu [title] Learn as much about your baby's medical condition as possible. en: Personal Care and Style: [header] How to make a silk scarf [title] Go shopping. [step] The best silk fabrics are usually light georgette, organza and crepes. The best designs and widest variety can be found in privately owned fabric stores, but keep your eyes open.

en: Personal Care and Style: [header] How to do ombre (dip dye) hair at home [title] Start with a 1 day old hair. [step] Starting with a two day old hair really can protect your hair from extreme damaging. Why? When you don't wash your hair for 1 day, you will notice that your hair is oily and greasy.
sl: Osebna nega in stil: Kako narediti ombre (potopno barvanje) lase doma. Začnite z 1 dan starimi lasmi. Če začnete z dvodnevnimi lasmi, lahko resnično zaščitite svoje lase pred ekstremnimi poškodbami. Zakaj? Ko si las ne umivate 1 dan, boste opazili, da so vaši lasje mastni in mastni.

en: Food and Entertaining: [header] How to prepare dark chocolate fondue [title] Make the easy dark chocolate fondue. [step] Measure 1 cup (236 ml) of heavy whipping cream into a medium saucepan and turn the heat to medium. When the cream starts to bubble a little, turn off the heat and whisk in 12 ounces (340 g) of chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of salt.

Ko začne smetana rahlo brbotati, ugasnite ogenj in vanjo vmešajte 12 unč (340 g) nasekljane temne čokolade in ščepec soli.

en: Personal Care and Style: [header] How to get rid of red and irritated skin on a nose [title] Wash your face daily with a gentle cleanser for sensitive skin.
